findings.current: As I suspected. You are an idiot. Cheongpung, you’re far too naïve for your age.
findings.defect: Great Sir calls Cheongpung by the wrong name, Kang Pung; the draft removes the setup for Cheongpung’s correction.
findings.rationale: 강풍 is Kang Pung, not 청풍.
findings.replacement: As I suspected. You are an idiot. Kang Pung, you’re far too naïve for your age.
findings.source: 강풍 자네는 나이에 비해 너무 어리숙한 면이 있어.

findings.defect: Great Sir repeats the wrong name while insisting he was right; the draft makes him say the correct name.
findings.rationale: The repeated 강풍 completes the wrong-name joke.
findings.replacement: “That’s exactly what I said. Kang Pung.”
findings.source: 내 말이 바로 그 말일세. 강풍.

findings.current: “You only just started talking to me, and be honest. You don’t remember why you came, do you?”
findings.defect: Cheongpung says this was the first time he called Great Sir, rebutting the accusation that he keeps calling him. The draft instead comments on when Great Sir started talking.
findings.rationale: 처음 불렀고 answers 왜 자꾸 부르나 directly.
findings.replacement: “That was the first time I called you. And be honest—you don’t remember why you came, do you?”
findings.source: 처음 불렀고, 솔직히 말씀하세요. 뭐 때문에 왔는지 기억 안 나시죠?

findings.current: Though he ended up inside the belly of the White Head Mountains.
findings.defect: The draft turns 백두강산 into mountains with a belly, rather than preserving the named possessor of that belly.
findings.rationale: 백두강산의 뱃속 identifies whose belly he entered; “the White Head Mountains” changes the referent.
findings.replacement: Though he ended up in Baekdu Gangsan’s belly.

findings.current: facing him from a hundred-odd yards away
findings.defect: The draft substitutes yards for 장, reducing the separation to less than a third of the source distance.
findings.rationale: A hundred-odd 장 is roughly a thousand feet, not a hundred yards.
findings.replacement: facing him from more than three hundred yards away
findings.source: 백여 장의 거리를 두고 마주 선

findings.current: Did you eat some rotten outhouse shit by mistake?
findings.defect: The insult changes foul wastewater into feces and makes the image more explicit.
findings.rationale: 하오수 refers to wastewater; the source’s coarse 처먹었나 supports the insult, not the substituted substance.
findings.replacement: Did you swallow some rotten sewage by mistake?

summary: The draft loses Great Sir’s wrong-name joke, changes a person into a mountain range, and substantially shortens the distance between the two kings.
